## How it works

- [statement] Atlas database users are separate from Atlas application users. Management roles govern Atlas UI/API actions, while database roles determine access when clients connect to clusters. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-users.md · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/auth/authorization.md, https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/opensource/decoupling-authorization-at-scale-mongodb-atlas-and-cedar-based-resource-policies/
- [statement] Atlas recommends assigning the minimum required permissions and using fine-grained custom database roles when predefined privileges are too broad; those roles can scope actions to particular databases and collections. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/auth/authorization.md · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-roles.md, https://docs.atlan.com/apps/connectors/database/mongodb/how-tos/set-up-mongodb
- [statement] An Atlas custom role that grants insert can permit collection creation even when CREATE_COLLECTION is absent. A Terraform report reproduced this behavior, and the MongoDB privilege reference lists create among commands authorized by insert. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/issues/1963 · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/privilege-actions/

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Atlas custom-role actions cover a subset of the actions available to built-in roles; a custom role cannot be assumed to reproduce every built-in capability. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-roles.md · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Database role grants combine: Atlas applies custom roles together with built-in roles and directly assigned privileges, and a more restrictive role does not cancel a higher permission granted by another role. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-roles.md · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-users.md
- [statement] Atlas database users can access all clusters and federated database instances in their project by default; administrators can restrict a user to selected instances. Resource scoping must therefore be reviewed separately from role selection. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-users.md · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC · also: https://docs.atlan.com/apps/connectors/database/mongodb/how-tos/set-up-mongodb, https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/api-docs/secret/databases/mongodbatlas
- [statement] Atlas requires database users and roles to be managed through the Atlas UI, Atlas CLI, Atlas Administration API, or a supported integration; otherwise Atlas rolls back those modifications. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-users.md · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-roles.md
- [statement] Atlas supports temporary database users that expire automatically, making time-bounded access possible without leaving permanent database credentials. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/architecture/current/auth/authorization.md · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-users.md
- [statement] In Terraform issue 1522, assigning a custom role against an application database produced HTTP 400 UNSUPPORTED_ROLE. Setting roles.database_name to admin fixed the assignment; the custom role resource still defined the actual database and collection privileges. Maintainers documented this distinction in January 2024. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/terraform-provider-mongodbatlas/issues/1522 · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC
- [statement] Atlan documents a metadata-crawling custom role using listDatabases, sqlGetSchema, dbStats, listCollections, and collStats. Its JDBC validation also requires find, which its recipe scopes to a nonexistent collection to avoid reading existing collection contents. This is connector-specific guidance, not a universal Atlas requirement. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-23) — https://docs.atlan.com/apps/connectors/database/mongodb/how-tos/set-up-mongodb · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC
- [statement] Atlas can combine a built-in role, multiple custom roles, and specific privileges for one database user; specific privileges can target individual databases and collections. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-users.md · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-roles.md
- [statement] HashiCorp provides an Atlas-specific Vault database plugin that generates unique, ephemeral database-user credentials from configured roles. (high confidence) — https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/api-docs/secret/databases/mongodbatlas · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC · also: https://github.com/hashicorp/vault-plugin-database-mongodbatlas
- [statement] The Vault Atlas database plugin accepts role assignments and a scopes array in creation statements. If scopes is omitted, the plugin defaults to all scopes, so credential automation must explicitly preserve intended deployment restrictions. (high confidence) — https://developer.hashicorp.com/vault/api-docs/secret/databases/mongodbatlas · keywords: Atlas Access Control and RBAC · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/atlas/security-add-mongodb-users.md
